title: T02 Why Do Crypto Prices Move?

lines.text: Lesson two: why do crypto prices move? Let's find out who really sets the price.
lines.say: Lesson two: why do crypto prices move? Let's find out who really sets the price.

lines.text: Here's a puzzle. At ten o'clock, BTC costs 60,000 USDT.
lines.say: Here's a puzzle. At ten o'clock, B-T-C costs sixty thousand U-S-D-T.

lines.text: A minute later it's higher. Then lower. Nobody pressed a button.
lines.say: A minute later it's higher. Then lower. Nobody pressed a button.

lines.text: So who decides? Buyers and sellers.
lines.say: So who decides? Buyers and sellers.

lines.text: Every price comes from a market: people who want to buy, and people who want to sell.
lines.say: Every price comes from a market: people who want to buy, and people who want to sell.

lines.text: A buyer pays to get BTC. A seller gives up BTC to get paid.
lines.say: A buyer pays to get B-T-C. A seller gives up B-T-C to get paid.

lines.text: When a buyer and a seller agree on a price, a trade happens.
lines.say: When a buyer and a seller agree on a price, a trade happens.

lines.text: The price of the latest trade is what we call the market price.
lines.say: The price of the latest trade is what we call the market price.

lines.text: Demand means how much people want to buy, and at what price.
lines.say: Demand means how much people want to buy, and at what price.

lines.text: Think of the last mangoes at a busy stall. When many want them, the seller can ask more.
lines.say: Think of the last mangoes at a busy stall. When many want them, the seller can ask more.

lines.text: Here, more buyers arrive than sellers. To get BTC, buyers offer a little more.
lines.say: Here, more buyers arrive than sellers. To get B-T-C, buyers offer a little more.

lines.text: Each new trade is a bit higher, so the price ticks up.
lines.say: Each new trade is a bit higher, so the price ticks up.

lines.text: Supply means how much people want to sell, and at what price.
lines.say: Supply means how much people want to sell, and at what price.

lines.text: Think of a fish seller near closing time with lots left. To sell it all, she cuts her price.
lines.say: Think of a fish seller near closing time with lots left. To sell it all, she cuts her price.

lines.text: Now more sellers arrive than buyers. To find a buyer, sellers accept less.
lines.say: Now more sellers arrive than buyers. To find a buyer, sellers accept less.

lines.text: We call this selling pressure. The price ticks down.
lines.say: We call this selling pressure. The price ticks down.

lines.text: Let's measure a move. Change is the new price minus the old price.
lines.say: Let's measure a move. Change is the new price minus the old price.

lines.text: From 60,000 to 61,200 USDT, the change is plus 1,200 USDT.
lines.say: From sixty thousand to sixty-one thousand two hundred U-S-D-T, the change is plus one thousand two hundred U-S-D-T.

lines.text: As a percent: 1,200 divided by 60,000, times 100, is 2 percent.
lines.say: As a percent: one thousand two hundred divided by sixty thousand, times one hundred, is two percent.

lines.text: From 60,000 down to 57,000: minus 3,000 USDT, or minus 5 percent.
lines.say: From sixty thousand down to fifty-seven thousand: minus three thousand U-S-D-T, or minus five percent.

lines.text: Now a simple model to watch. It's illustrative only, not a prediction of real markets.
lines.say: Now a simple model to watch. It's illustrative only, not a prediction of real markets.

lines.text: Buyers stronger than sellers? The model price drifts up.
lines.say: Buyers stronger than sellers? The model price drifts up.

lines.text: Sellers stronger? It drifts down.
lines.say: Sellers stronger? It drifts down.

lines.text: When both sides are about equal, the price wobbles sideways, with no clear direction.
lines.say: When both sides are about equal, the price wobbles sideways, with no clear direction.

lines.text: Careful: price doesn't simply follow how many people are buying or selling.
lines.say: Careful: price doesn't simply follow how many people are buying or selling.

lines.text: Here, 3 buyers each want 4 BTC. That's 12 BTC in total.
lines.say: Here, three buyers each want four B-T-C. That's twelve B-T-C in total.

lines.text: And 10 sellers offer only 0.2 BTC each. That's just 2 BTC.
lines.say: And ten sellers offer only zero point two B-T-C each. That's just two B-T-C.

lines.text: Fewer people, but far more BTC wanted. Size matters, not headcount.
lines.say: Fewer people, but far more B-T-C wanted. Size matters, not headcount.

lines.text: Liquidity means how easily you can buy or sell without moving the price much.
lines.say: Liquidity means how easily you can buy or sell without moving the price much.

lines.text: Left: a busy market with lots of BTC for sale at each price. Right: a quiet one.
lines.say: Left: a busy market with lots of B-T-C for sale at each price. Right: a quiet one.

lines.text: Now someone buys 1 BTC, in both markets.
lines.say: Now someone buys one B-T-C, in both markets.

lines.text: Busy market: the price stays put. Quiet market: it jumps 400 USDT.
lines.say: Busy market: the price stays put. Quiet market: it jumps four hundred U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Volatility is how much and how fast a price swings.
lines.say: Volatility is how much and how fast a price swings.

lines.text: A calm market moves a little. A volatile one swings hard, up and down.
lines.say: A calm market moves a little. A volatile one swings hard, up and down.

lines.text: Surprise news, or a quiet market with few orders, can cause sudden jumps.
lines.say: Surprise news, or a quiet market with few orders, can cause sudden jumps.

lines.text: Crypto is known for high volatility.
lines.say: Crypto is known for high volatility.

lines.text: A common mistake: picturing price as a smooth line you can simply follow.
lines.say: A common mistake: picturing price as a smooth line you can simply follow.

lines.text: Zoom in, and real price paths are jagged, full of small ups and downs.
lines.say: Zoom in, and real price paths are jagged, full of small ups and downs.

lines.text: Nobody knows the next tick. A neat trend can turn around at any moment.
lines.say: Nobody knows the next tick. A neat trend can turn around at any moment.

lines.text: Your turn. BTC moves from 60,000 to 63,000 USDT. What's the change, in USDT and in percent?
lines.say: Your turn. B-T-C moves from sixty thousand to sixty-three thousand U-S-D-T. What's the change, in U-S-D-T and in percent?

lines.text: Answer: plus 3,000 USDT. And 3,000 divided by 60,000, times 100, is 5 percent.
lines.say: Answer: plus three thousand U-S-D-T. And three thousand divided by sixty thousand, times one hundred, is five percent.

lines.text: Before you go further, know the risks.
lines.say: Before you go further, know the risks.

lines.text: News or a quiet market can move prices fast, in either direction.
lines.say: News or a quiet market can move prices fast, in either direction.

lines.text: Nobody knows the next move. Not experts, not apps, not AI.
lines.say: Nobody knows the next move. Not experts, not apps, not AI.

lines.text: When things look unclear, you can always wait. Not trading is a valid choice.
lines.say: When things look unclear, you can always wait. Not trading is a valid choice.

lines.text: And remember: today's model was illustrative, not real market data.
lines.say: And remember: today's model was illustrative, not real market data.

lines.text: Let's recap. Prices move as buyers and sellers trade. The latest trade is the market price.
lines.say: Let's recap. Prices move as buyers and sellers trade. The latest trade is the market price.

lines.text: More demand tends to push price up. More supply tends to push it down.
lines.say: More demand tends to push price up. More supply tends to push it down.

lines.text: Liquidity and news shape how fast and how far it moves.
lines.say: Liquidity and news shape how fast and how far it moves.

lines.text: Check yourself: many sellers, few buyers. Which way does price tend to move?
lines.say: Check yourself: many sellers, few buyers. Which way does price tend to move?

lines.text: Down, as sellers accept less. But nothing is guaranteed.
lines.say: Down, as sellers accept less. But nothing is guaranteed.

lines.text: Great work! Next up: trading pairs, and what BTC/USDT really means.
lines.say: Great work! Next up: trading pairs, and what B-T-C U-S-D-T really means.
